cards.ex: With rising sea levels, entire coastal communities have their future at stake.
cards.exUz: Dengiz sathining ko'tarilishi bilan butun qirg'oq jamoalarining kelajagi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning xavf ostida ekanligini bildiradi, yo'qotilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Environmental stewardship is crucial for ensuring a healthy planet for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun sog'lom sayyorani ta'minlash uchun ekologik boshqaruv juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni asrash va to'g'ri boshqarish mas'uliyati.

cards.ex: Resource depletion is a major concern as the global population continues to grow.
cards.exUz: Global aholi soni o'sishi bilan resurslarning kamayishi katta muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy resurslarning tugab borishi, kamayishi.

cards.ex: Companies can offset their emissions by investing in reforestation projects.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar o'rmonlarni qayta tiklash loyihalariga sarmoya kiritish orqali o'z emissiyalarini qoplashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Chiqarilgan gazlarni kamaytirish uchun boshqa joyda choralarni ko'rish.

cards.ex: Madagascar is a biodiversity hotspot, home to species found nowhere else on Earth.
cards.exUz: Madagaskar - bioxilma-xillik markazi, Yer yuzida boshqa hech qayerda topilmaydigan turlarning vatani.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p turli xil o'simlik va hayvonot dunyosiga ega bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: Hopefully, with these new policies, the company can weather the storm of increased scrutiny.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamizki, ushbu yangi siyosatlar bilan kompaniya ortib borayotgan nazorat bo'roni ostida qola oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin davrni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazish, bardosh berish.

cards.ex: Some communities still live off the land, relying on traditional farming methods.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi jamoalar hali ham yerdan kun ko'rib, an'anaviy dehqonchilik usullariga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Yerda yetishtirilgan mahsulotlar bilan yashash, o'zini ta'minlash.

cards.ex: The company aims to become carbon neutral by 2030.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya 2030 yilgacha uglerod neytral bo'lishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Chiqarilgan va yutilgan uglerod miqdori teng bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: The money we've raised is a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed to solve the crisis.
cards.exUz: Biz yig'gan pul inqirozni hal qilish uchun zarur bo'lgan mablag'lar bilan solishtirganda dengizdan tomchi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik va ahamiyatsiz miqdor, katta muammoni hal qilmaydi.

cards.ex: It's a shame to see so much food going to waste when people are starving.
cards.exUz: Odamlar och qolganda bunchalik ko'p oziq-ovqatning behuda ketayotganini ko'rish achinarli.
cards.uzDef: Ishlatilmasdan yoki qadrlanmasdan yo'qolmoq.

cards.ex: The city has launched a green initiative to promote cycling and reduce traffic congestion.
cards.exUz: Shahar velosiped haydashni rag'batlantirish va tirbandlikni kamaytirish uchun yashil tashabbusni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishga qaratilgan har qanday tadbir.

cards.ex: More and more people are becoming eco-conscious in their daily lives.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq odamlar kundalik hayotlarida ekologik ongli bo'lib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga ta'sirini o'ylab harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Many species are on the brink of extinction due to habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlar yashash muhitining yo'qolishi tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketish arafasida.
cards.uzDef: Yomon holatga yaqin, muammoga duch kelish arafasida.

cards.ex: The company is committed to implementing sustainable practices throughout its operations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z faoliyati davomida barqaror amaliyotlarni joriy etishga sodiq.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlar uchun zarar yetkazmasdan foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan usullar.

cards.ex: Reducing food miles by buying locally can help lower your carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Mahalliy mahsulotlarni sotib olish orqali oziq-ovqat masofasini kamaytirish sizning uglerod izingizni kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining tashilishi uchun bosib o'tgan masofa.

cards.ex: Deforestation and climate change create a vicious cycle that is difficult to break.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi va iqlim o'zgarishi buzish qiyin bo'lgan yomon aylanishni yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta muammo boshqa muammoga olib keladigan, undan chiqish qiyin.

cards.ex: The nature preserve provides a safe haven for endangered species.
cards.exUz: Tabiat qo'riqxonasi yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlar uchun xavfsiz joydir.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni muhofaza qilish uchun maxsus ajratilgan hudud.

cards.ex: If we don't act now, all our efforts to protect the environment will go down the drain.
cards.exUz: Agar hozir harakat qilmasak, atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha barcha harakatlarimiz shamolga sovuriladi.
cards.uzDef: Befoyda sarflanmoq, yo'qolmoq.

cards.ex: Urban sprawl is encroaching on valuable farmland and natural habitats.
cards.exUz: Shaharning kengayishi qimmatli qishloq xo'jaligi yerlari va tabiiy muhitga zarar yetkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning tartibsiz ravishda kengayishi.

cards.ex: Climate change is a pressing issue that requires immediate action.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi - bu zudlik bilan harakat qilishni talab qiladigan dolzarb masala.
cards.uzDef: Tezda hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan muhim muammo.

cards.ex: Pollution is taking its toll on the health of the local residents.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish mahalliy aholi salomatligiga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoqda.

cards.ex: We need to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to mitigate climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishini yumshatish uchun issiqxona gazlari chiqindilarini kamaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzini isitadigan gazlarning chiqarilishi.

cards.ex: Environmental degradation is a serious problem affecting many parts of the world.
cards.exUz: Ekologik tanazzul dunyoning ko'p qismlariga ta'sir qilayotgan jiddiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitning yomonlashuvi, buzilishi.

cards.ex: The circular economy aims to minimize waste and maximize the use of resources.
cards.exUz: Aylana iqtisodiyot chiqindilarni kamaytirish va resurslardan foydalanishni maksimal darajaga yetkazishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni tejashga qaratilgan iqtisodiyot modeli.

cards.ex: We should strive to leave a legacy of environmental responsibility for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun ekologik mas'uliyat merosini qoldirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlar uchun muhim va foydali narsa qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: Fisheries management aims to ensure sustainable yield of fish stocks.
cards.exUz: Baliqchilikni boshqarish baliq zaxiralarining barqaror hosildorligini ta'minlashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni tugatmasdan olish mumkin bo'lgan miqdor.

cards.ex: We all need to be part of the solution to tackle climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish uchun hammamiz yechimning bir qismi bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilishga yordam berish, hissa qo'shish.

cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about the importance of protecting our forests.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarimizni muhofaza qilish muhimligi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammo haqida odamlarning bilimini oshirish.

cards.ex: It's time to stop talking and take action to reduce pollution.
cards.exUz: Gaplashishni to'xtatib, ifloslanishni kamaytirish uchun chora ko'rish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun aniq harakatlar qilish.

cards.ex: Protecting biodiversity is essential for a healthy planet.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom sayyora uchun bioxilma-xillikni himoya qilish juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'simlik va hayvonot dunyosini muhofaza qilish.
